environment.description: Same Actix-web service deployed on a hardened Kubernetes pod with the following runtime configuration: (1) The pod spec includes a Projected Volume for /var/app/uploads backed by an emptyDir with medium: Memory, meaning the tmpfs mount has specific kernel-level inode constraints. (2) The pod's securityContext sets a custom SELinux type (container_file_t with MCS label s0:c412,c877) applied via seLinuxOptions on the volume mount, which prevents following symlinks that target files outside the labeled context. (3) The container runtime is CRI-O 1.28+ with the 'follow_symlinks=false' annotation on the runtime class (io.kubernetes.cri-o.FollowSymlinks: "false"), which instructs the OCI runtime to bind-mount with RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS flag on all path resolution within annotated volume mounts. Credential rotation occurs via a Kubernetes Secret mounted as a projected volume at /var/app/uploads/.credentials/ with rotation happening through the kubelet's secret sync (not file writes), making the credential path itself immune to symlink substitution.

config.credential_rotation: kubelet projected volume sync, secret object rotated by external-secrets-operator every 60s, old secret versions invalidated by token-bound service account issuer
